errors.text_span: ranging from 0 to 60 on a linear scale
errors.evidence: While the y-axis labels go up to 60, the data range extends higher, with the first data point being approximately 70%. Therefore, stating the range is 0 to 60 is inaccurate for the data shown.

errors.text_span: At the start of the x-axis (1 blank), the accuracy is 60%.
errors.evidence: The data point for 1 blank is clearly above the 60% grid line, at a value of approximately 70%.
The data point at 2 blanks is slightly above the 20% grid line, at approximately 22%.
The data point at 3 blanks is significantly below 10% (the midpoint between 0 and 20), at a value of approximately 4-5%.

errors.text_span: dropping to 0% at both 4 and 5 blanks
errors.evidence: The data point at 4 blanks is slightly above the 0% line, while the point at 5 blanks is at 0%. Stating it is 0% for both is incorrect.
